# fixmyPhone

> fixmyPhone is a smartphone repair business in Mysore (Mysuru), Karnataka, India, offering free doorstep pick-up and delivery for repairs. It fixes screens, batteries, charging ports, cameras, speakers/mics, back glass, water damage, and software issues on all major phone brands.

## Business details

- Address: # 2259, Bogadhi 2nd stage, Mysuru, Karnataka 570009, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 9008419525
- Email: support@gofixmyphone.com
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 9:00 AM–7:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
- Payment accepted: Cash, UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), bank transfer
- Warranty: 30-day warranty on parts and labour for every repair, including free re-repair and free pick-up if the same issue recurs.
- Service area: Free pick-up and delivery across Mysore city, including Bogadhi, Vijayanagar, VV Mohalla, Saraswathipuram, Kuvempunagar, Hebbal, JP Nagar, Gokulam, Lakshmipuram, Jayalakshmipuram, Yadavagiri, and Dattagalli.
- Brands serviced: Apple, Samsung, Google, OnePlus, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Motorola, Nothing, and other brands on request.

## Starting prices (in INR, subject to model and part grade)

- Software Issues: from ₹399
- Speaker & Mic Repair: from ₹499
- Charging Port Repair: from ₹599
- Battery Replacement: from ₹799
- Camera Repair: from ₹899
- Water Damage Repair: from ₹999
- Back Glass Repair: from ₹1,199
- Screen Replacement: from ₹1,499

## How it works

1. Request a free quote online, by phone, or via WhatsApp.
2. fixmyPhone calls to confirm the issue and schedule a doorstep pick-up.
3. The device is picked up, repaired at the workshop, and delivered back at no extra cost.
